description: Source file implementing UNIX-specific file descriptor management functions for the libwebsockets library, including functions to map file descriptors to websocket instances, insert and delete socket instances from internal lookup tables, and manage polling events.

methods.name: struct:lws * wsi_from_fd(const struct lws_context * context,int fd)
methods.description: Retrieve a websocket instance associated with a given file descriptor.
methods.returns: pointer to struct lws or NULL if not found

methods.name: int sanity_assert_no_wsi_traces(const struct lws_context * context,struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Assert that the specified websocket instance is not present in the lookup table.

methods.name: int sanity_assert_no_sockfd_traces(const struct lws_context * context,lws_sockfd_type sfd)
methods.description: Assert that a given socket file descriptor is not present in the lookup table.

methods.name: int insert_wsi(const struct lws_context * context,struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Insert a websocket instance into the lookup table associated with the context.
methods.returns: 0 on success, 1 if max fds reached

methods.name: void delete_from_fd(const struct lws_context * context,int fd)
methods.description: Remove a websocket instance associated with a given file descriptor from the lookup table.

methods.name: void delete_from_fdwsi(const struct lws_context * context,struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Remove a websocket instance from the lookup table by pointer.

methods.name: void lws_plat_insert_socket_into_fds(struct lws_context * context,struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Add a socket to the platform-specific polling mechanism.

methods.name: void lws_plat_delete_socket_from_fds(struct lws_context * context,struct lws * wsi,int m)
methods.description: Remove a socket from the platform-specific polling mechanism.

methods.name: int lws_plat_change_pollfd(struct lws_context * context,struct lws * wsi,struct lws_pollfd * pfd)
methods.description: Update the polling configuration for a websocket instance.

ctags.name: lws_plat_change_pollfd
ctags.signature: (struct lws_context * context,struct lws * wsi,struct lws_pollfd * pfd)
